scripts.prepare:assets: node scripts/tokens.ts && node scripts/icons.ts && node packages/i18n/scripts/gen-locales.ts && node scripts/font-licenses.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/tokens.ts && pnpm --filter @clipcard/extension exec wxt prepare && vitest run
scripts.build:firefox: pnpm prepare:assets && pnpm --filter @clipcard/extension exec wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.build: pnpm prepare:assets && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @clipcard/extension build && pnpm build:landing && pnpm --filter @clipcard/lite build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prepare:assets && pnpm prepare:landing && tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p packages/cards/gallery/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @clipcard/extension --filter @clipcard/landing --filter @clipcard/lite --fail-if-no-match -r typecheck
